blocks.h2: Sump Pumps Below Lincoln Park Garden Units
blocks.body: In a building with a garden apartment, the sump pump protects living space, not just storage. Pumps in these pits often run hard during spring rain. We test the pump, the float and the check valve, make sure the discharge goes to the right place and add a battery backup that takes over in an outage. A high-water alarm lets the residents below know right away if something goes wrong.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Sump Pump Work
blocks.body: The pump size and type, a battery backup and an alarm are the main pieces. A new pit or discharge changes add more. We test and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Sump Pump Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Does a garden unit need a battery backup?
items.answer: Yes. If someone lives below grade, a backup pump is worth it.

items.q: How long do sump pumps last?
Is a sump pump the same as an ejector pump?
items.answer: No. A sump pump moves groundwater out of a pit. An [ejector pump](/chicago-lincoln-park/ejector-pump) moves wastewater from basement fixtures.

items.q: Can you add a sump pump where there isn't one?
items.answer: Often. We cut a pit where water collects and run the discharge outside.

items.q: Where should a sump pump discharge on a city lot?
items.preview: Away from the building, where local rules allow.
items.answer: Away from the foundation, following city rules. We'll route it properly.

items.q: Can a sump pump be added under a finished garden unit?
items.answer: Sometimes, if there's a spot for the pit and a path for the discharge.

items.q: How much does sump pump repair cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the pump and backup. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the pump, the pit and whether you add a backup. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
